benchmark.zero_cutoff_policy: literal_gte: an observed zero passes when percentile cutoff equals zero; do not silently add a positive-only gate
benchmark.chart_percentile_method: midrank; for sorted n>1 use 100*(lower_bound + 0.5*(tie_count-1))/(n-1); singleton=50
benchmark.thresholds: pinned P95/P99 from release when supplied; other thresholds PERCENTILE.INC over valid values; validate pinned thresholds against release cohort

tier_screen.qualifyingTier: minimum_positive_confirmed_building_or_activity_tier; enabled extra metric with confirmed pass qualifies at Tier 3
tier_screen.tierEligible: qualifyingTier is not null AND qualifyingTier <= maxDemandTier
tier_screen.application: applies only to confirmed high-demand locations; demandMode=all keeps confirmed low-demand selected patterns without applying the tier gate; unknown demand remains excluded
tier_screen.classification_unchanged: DemandHigh and 8 patterns still follow original high/low thresholds, independently from the maxTier gate and weights

supply.unknown_assumption: U covers countable, in-boundary operating sites whose only uncertainty is own vs competitor brand; enumerate B+k and C+U-k for integer k in [0,U]. Other uncertainties require production review.

map_score.note: Existing max-percentile map score is retained and must be labelled Demand signal. Weighted rankScore is a separate field; do not relabel the existing heat scale as rankScore.

passingSignalCount.role: legacy_order_only; weighted mode does not use this as a tie-breaker

preferred_location_types.section_th: รูปแบบทำเลที่สนใจ

legacy_ranking_order: source_rank_asc; production additionally place_id_asc for deterministic ties

weighted_ranking.formula: (wDemand * demandScore + wOwnGap * ownGap + wCompetitorGap * competitorGap) / sum(rankingWeights)
weighted_ranking.demand_group_score: sum(metricWeight * metricPercentile) / sum(active positive metricWeights) within each enabled group
weighted_ranking.demand_score: sum(groupWeight * groupScore) / sum(positive demandGroupWeights over enabled groups)
weighted_ranking.disabled_group_weights: ignored; extra default50 takes effect only when extraMetrics is nonempty
weighted_ranking.zero_metric_weight: excludes metric from ranking only; threshold hits and tier screening still use enabled metric

gaps.meaning: fewer observed branches gives a higher gap score; not a sales forecast or proof of feasibility

weighted_ranking.missing: retain full configured weight; missing metric percentile contributes lower=0, upper=100. Never renormalize weights over observed values only.
weighted_ranking.unknown_supply: if B/C/U is not a non-negative integer, both gap components use [0,100]; otherwise enumerate every integer k=0..U with B+k and C+U-k, and calculate weighted combined supply minimum/maximum across these same allocations
weighted_ranking.bounds: rankScore combines demand lower with joint supply lower; rankUpper combines demand upper with joint supply upper; never combine independent marginal supply extrema
weighted_ranking.stars: explanatory pattern labels only; not a primary weighted ranking term

weight_field_keys.metricWeights: all ready IDs from METRICS; future connected metrics require versioned update

return_fields.rankScore: conservative weighted lower bound on 0..100 scale
return_fields.rankUpper: weighted upper bound, shown as uncertainty
return_fields.rankCoverage: 0..1 weighted share from known demand observations and fully resolved supply (U=0); it is evidence coverage, not confidence probability
return_fields.qualifyingTier: best confirmed enabled-group tier, or null
return_fields.tierEligible: confirmed tier fits maxDemandTier; false for low demand where tier is not applicable

migration.missing_fields: fill defaults; preserve saved values, criteria version, events, POIs and shortlisted locations
migration.storage_cross_tab: normalize incoming criteria the same way; ignore malformed JSON
migration.human_changes: diffCriteria records each nested ranking/group/metric weight independently with readable fieldNames
